tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “agency” has the meaning given the term in section 3502 of title 44.

tree.heading: Agency information system
tree.text: The term “agency information system” has the meaning given the term in section 660 of this title.

children.text: the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs of the Senate; and
the Committee on Homeland Security of the House of Representatives.

tree.heading: Cybersecurity risk; information system
tree.text: The terms “cybersecurity risk” and “information system” have the meanings given those terms in section 650 of this title.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the Office of Management and Budget.

tree.heading: Intelligence community
tree.text: The term “intelligence community” has the meaning given the term in section 3003(4) of title 50.

tree.heading: National security system
tree.text: The term “national security system” has the meaning given the term in section 11103 of title 40.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Homeland Security.

notes.text: References in TextThis subchapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this subtitle”, meaning subtitle B (§§ 221–229) of title II of div. N of Pub. L. 114–113, which is classified principally to this subchapter. For complete classification of subtitle B to the Code, see Tables.
